spirits.name: IAI STRIKE
spirits.flavor: One draw. One cut. The ball arrives before the defense blinks.

spirits.name: KAGE STEP
spirits.flavor: Shadow footwork: every tackler grabs only an afterimage.

spirits.name: IRON WALL
spirits.flavor: The line becomes a castle wall marching forward.

spirits.name: HAWK EYE
spirits.flavor: Sees the throw before the quarterback decides it.

spirits.name: LASER LINE
spirits.flavor: Neon-hot, ruler-straight, and absolutely on time.

spirits.name: NEON DRIFT
spirits.flavor: Drifts through traffic like a car sliding through a midnight corner.

spirits.name: GHOST PICK
spirits.flavor: She was never covering him. She was waiting for the ball.

spirits.name: LANDSLIDE
spirits.flavor: A mountain decides to move downhill.

spirits.name: BULWARK
spirits.flavor: The pocket becomes a fortress; the hole becomes a highway.

spirits.name: QUAKE
spirits.flavor: Every hit registers on the seismograph.
